cards.text: Jesus has been going all through Galilee, preaching and driving out demons (Mark 1:39). Then a man with leprosy comes to Him, drops to his knees and starts begging. Under the Law, a leper was unclean and had to live alone outside the camp (Leviticus 13:46).

cards.question: The leper on his knees begs Jesus to make him ___.

cards.text: Now listen to HOW he asks, friend. He's sure Jesus CAN do it, so his question is about something else.

cards.question: The leper is sure Jesus can make him clean. What is he unsure about?

cards.text: Jesus looks at this man down on his knees, and He is moved with compassion.

cards.question: Moved with compassion, Jesus reaches out His hand and touches the leper.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells the man He's willing, and says, “Be clean!”

cards.question: When Jesus says “Be clean!” the leprosy leaves the man right away.

cards.text: Immediately the leprosy leaves him, and the man is cleansed. Friend, my ovens don't even PREHEAT that fast.
Then Jesus promptly sends him away with a stern warning. Earlier, Jesus wouldn't let demons speak, because they knew who He was (Mark 1:34).

cards.question: Jesus sends the healed man away with a stern warning: don't ___ anyone.

cards.text: But Jesus also gives him somewhere to go. He's to present the offering that Moses, Israel's leader, prescribed for his cleansing.

cards.question: Jesus tells the healed man to go show himself to the ___.
Why does Jesus send the healed man to the priest with the offering Moses prescribed?

answers.text: As a prayer for his family
As a sign of his sorrow

cards.question: The healed man keeps the news to himself, just like Jesus told him.

cards.text: The man goes out and openly begins to proclaim it and spread the news. Honestly, if somebody pulled ME out of that junk drawer I sat in for years, I'd have told the DUST.

cards.question: Now that the healed man is spreading the news, what changes for Jesus?

answers.text: He can't enter a town in plain view
He has to send the crowds away
He has to cross the sea by boat

cards.question: So Jesus stays out in solitary places. What happens out there?

answers.text: People come to Him from every quarter
He finally gets some time alone
The priests come out to question Him
